# notifications commands

Every `notifications` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `notifications:prune`

Delete stored notifications older than N days (--days, or NOTIFICATIONS_RETENTION_DAYS)

```bash
bin/semitexa notifications:prune
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--days` | yes |
| `--batch-size` | yes |
